title: Built a 3D Zombie Survival Game in One-Shot with Gemini 3.8 + Three.js
author: shoonee_balavolka
selftext:
Hi.

I've noticed everyone else is making games with Astro, but today I tried making a game with Gemini 3.8.

I made a simple zombie game based on Tree.js, and I think the quality is better than I expected.

All the assets have been created in Gemini as well.

comments.author: BeyondAffinity
comments.body: I am baffled how easy this got all of a sudden thinking back how it was just 6 months ago.

replies.author: AxiosXiphos
replies.body: Four years ago this would have been considered sci-fi.

replies.author: shoonee_balavolka
replies.body: It really feels like I'm living in a science fiction drama.

replies.author: shoonee_balavolka
replies.body:
That's right.
All I did was submit the design documents properly, and even I find it amazing!

comments.author: Any_Way6450
comments.body: Hey bro, im full noob with game dev, um can send a basic tutorial or prompt to star create mu own? I have claude code, gemini pro and codex but no idea how use this the right form and fell burn my tokens ;(

replies.author: shoonee_balavolka
replies.body:
I think it would be best to choose a game engine first.
I recommend Unity.
Look at examples to figure out what you can do with Unity, and start by making something simple.
Whether it's 2D or 3D, start by making something really simple, and once you get used to it, gradually expand your skills!
